arguments_exacts.prompt:
Generate one new Memlia editorial cover image, landscape 16:9.

STRICT COLOR REQUIREMENT — this is the primary acceptance criterion:
Use two large, flat, solid, highly saturated, uniform-color surfaces, with their visible unshaded interiors painted EXACTLY in sRGB #27b657 (RGB 39,182,87) and EXACTLY in sRGB #1c8a41 (RGB 28,138,65). Each of these two exact colors MUST occupy at least 5% of the entire image surface, independently. Aim for 10–15% of the total image area per exact color to ensure the minimum. Use sizeable contiguous regions, not thin trim or tiny accents. The two greens must be visually prominent. NO olive shift, NO blue shift, NO color grading, NO dark shadows, NO gradients, NO texture, NO ambient occlusion and NO lighting variation on these exact-color planar surfaces. Treat these surfaces as color-managed flat graphic fills, independent of lighting. Preserve the exact hex values in the final raster image. Do not print or write the hex values or any color swatch labels into the image.

Composition: an isometric 3D diorama, one open document folder on the left containing completely blank sheets, exactly three document trays neatly aligned to its right with blank paperwork distributed among them, and one round seal resting beside the final tray. Keep the round seal separate and at rest. No stamping action, no arrows and no sending action. Preserve this composition and use simple geometric forms and matte materials.

Color placement: make the open folder's large visible left inner panel and visible broad front panels of the first tray solid exact #27b657; make the folder's large visible back panel surrounding the blank sheets and visible broad front panels of the second and third trays solid exact #1c8a41. Use broad visible planar faces sized so each green independently covers at least 5% of the entire canvas. Simplify geometry and keep those green faces bright, perfectly uniform and free of any shadows. White blank paper should leave enough exposed large green areas to meet both minima. Small graphite #231f20 touches on the seal are allowed. Dominant background cream #fcfbf7.

Style: refined clean isometric 3D editorial diorama with abundant breathing room, simple geometry, matte surfaces, soft upper-left illumination and short cast shadows ONLY on the cream background or neutral paper. Flat exact green fills take precedence over realistic shading. No additional decorative objects.

STRICT PROHIBITIONS: no text, letters, numbers, logos, characters, people, client data, interface, red alert, automatic sending or suggestion of sending. All sheets must be completely blank.
